title: Cloud attempt records do not match the job_handle contract or local provenance
body: SandboxAttemptHandle (sandbox-executor.ts:125) is flat with no schema_version/issued_at/nested handle and ~15 extra top-level fields against contracts/job-protocol.json's closed job_handle; status uses running|exited|gone. Records also hard-code source_sha to forty zeros and refs/heads/main (epic-reconciler.ts:741-742,794). No test compares against Go-produced records.
